question_or_proposition: Whether the phrase 'that would cause the formation of a visible sheen or visible deposits on the bottom or shoreline, or would damage or impair the normal growth, function or reproduction of human, animal, plant or aquatic life' conditions the prohibition on discharge of oils, scum, grease, and other floating materials—so that such a discharge is prohibited only when it produces one of those enumerated effects—or whether the enumerated effects constitute separate, independently applicable prohibitions.
required_context: Target span under FLOATING SOLIDS OR VISIBLE FOAM (Page 5, Section part_i)

Adjacent structural context showing this Part I section is a narrative effluent condition without an accompanying numeric limit value or parameter-specific sampling-frequency table in the immediately surrounding pages
source_locator: gcc/final_permit.pdf, Page 5, Section part_i, FLOATING SOLIDS OR VISIBLE FOAM
notes: Resolution determines whether compliance is governed by a qualitative, effect-triggered standard versus material-presence or effect-only rules. That distinction changes whether related reported measurements receive numeric limit comparison (Purpose A), whether visual or effect-based monitoring is an applicable requirement (Purpose B), and how missing numeric or observational evidence should be classified (Purpose C).
